title: Dr. G. N. Singh has conferred “Dhanwantri Award for 2014”
bodyHtml: Dr. G. N. Singh has conferred “Dhanwantri Award for 2014” on 16th November for protecting Indian Tradition and Culture in the area of Health and Medicines by Akhil Bhartiya Vidhyat Parishad, Varanasi
